rows.AcceptText: Hello [PLAYERNAME], A number of our soldiers have been poisoned by spiders, could you help me gather the ingredients for an antidote?. The Spitting Spiders located around town should provide you with the necessary Venom for the antidote.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to gather Venom from Spitting Spiders around town.
rows.CompletedText: Thank you very much [PLAYERNAME], We still need a few more ingredients.
rows.ArchiveText: At the request from [STARTNAME] You gathered the first set of ingredients for [FINISHNAME]

rows.AcceptText: Hello [PLAYERNAME], The Venon is only the first Ingredient we need, I need you to travel south and gather Arachnid Teeth from the Spiders in Phantom Forest.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to gather Arachnid Teeth from Spiders located in Phantom Forest.
rows.CompletedText: Thank you very much [PLAYERNAME], I think this should be enough to complete the Antidote.
rows.ArchiveText: At the request from [STARTNAME] You gathered the second set of ingredients for [FINISHNAME]

rows.AcceptText: Hello [PLAYERNAME], It would seem the Poison is more advanced than we first suspected. We need to find the source of the paralysis, Could you gather some samples from the Spider Bats located in Phantom Forest?.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to gather Spider Curare from Spider Bats located in Phantom Forest.
rows.CompletedText: Thank you very much [PLAYERNAME], This should be enough to complete the antitode.
rows.ArchiveText: At the request from [STARTNAME] You gathered the final set of ingredients for [FINISHNAME]

rows.AcceptText: Hello [PLAYERNAME], I can't thank you enough for doing this, Please take the ingredients to [FINISHNAME] at the Bichon Town Potion Store.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to deliver the Ingredients to [FINISHNAME].
rows.CompletedText: Thank you very much [PLAYERNAME], It won't take me long to complete the antidote.
rows.ArchiveText: At the request from [STARTNAME] You gathered the final set of ingredients for [FINISHNAME]

rows.AcceptText: Hello [PLAYERNAME], I have completed the Antidote, Please deliver it to [FINISHNAME].
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to deliver the completed Antidote to [FINISHNAME].
rows.CompletedText: Thank you very much [PLAYERNAME], I'll get this to the soldiers immediately.
rows.ArchiveText: At the request from [STARTNAME] you delivered the Antidote to [FINISHNAME]

rows.AcceptText: Hello [PLAYERNAME], It's time we ended this threat, kill the ArachnidBroodmother responsible for spawning these defiled creatures.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to slay the Arachnid Broodmother located in Phantom Forest.
rows.CompletedText: Great work [PLAYERNAME]!, With the threat of the Broodmother gone we should be much safer.
rows.ArchiveText: At the request from [STARTNAME] You defeated the Arachnid Broodmother.

rows.AcceptText: Hello [PLAYERNAME], The Evil Elephants in Lost Paradise Forest have been trampling everything. Maybe you could lower their numbers in some way?
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to kill Evil Elephants in Lost Paradise Forest.
rows.CompletedText: That should give some breathing room for groups to grow, Thanks [PLAYERNAME].
rows.ArchiveText: [STARTNAME] had you successfully lower the population of Evil Elephants in Lost Paradise Forest.

rows._Identity: Time for the Fleas to Flee
rows.QuestName: Time for the Fleas to Flee
rows.AcceptText: Over here [PLAYERNAME]!, We could really do with clearing out the Flea Cave north west of here. Mind giving us a hand?
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to Clear out the Flea population in the cave to the North west of Banya Village.
rows.CompletedText: That will do nicely [PLAYERNAME].
rows.ArchiveText: You managed to clear out the Flea population that had infested Flea Cave at the request of [FINISHNAME]

rows.AcceptText: Greetings [PLAYERNAME], It's time for us reclaim the Carved Stone Tomb for ourselves. We need to work our way downwards into the bowels of the tomb and unlock the treasure within, Let's start with the Red and Black Boars that guard the tomb.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to kill the Red and Black Boars within the Carved Stone Tomb
rows.CompletedText: That's a great start [PLAYERNAME], Come back later for the next step in our plan.
rows.ArchiveText: You helped [STARTNAME] to clear out Black and Red Boars within the Carved Stone Tomb [FINISHNAME]

rows.AcceptText: That was a great job you did with the Boars[PLAYERNAME], We sent some explorer further into the Tomb and they returned with stories of Serpent like creatures and paralysing moths down there, Can you investigate and eliminate the threat for us?
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to Travel deeper into the Carved Stone Tomb in order to defeat the Claw Serpents and Wedge moths found within.
rows.CompletedText: I can only wish we never see those horrors again [PLAYERNAME], Have a rest and then we will discuss our next step.
rows.ArchiveText: You helped [STARTNAME] to defeat the Claw Serpents and Wedge Moths found within the Carved Stone Tomb [FINISHNAME]

rows.AcceptText: We are closing in on the deepest sections of the Carved Stone Tomb [PLAYERNAME], We've come across a grand entrance that we wish to enter. The room however is closely guarded by 2 TuskLords and creatures that continually overwhelm our explorers with their young, I don't like asking over and over but could you deal with it?
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to descend into some of the deepest sections of the Carved Stone Tomb in order to slay the TuskLords and WedgeMothLarva found there.
rows.CompletedText: It's done!, we can finally breach the door and seek the treasures within.
rows.ArchiveText: You helped [STARTNAME] to defeat the Tusklords and Wedge Moth Larva protecting the deepest sections of the Carved Stone Tomb [FINISHNAME]

rows.AcceptText: [PLAYERNAME] You must save us!, We didn't mean to unleash the creature within the Kings room. I cannot begin to describe the monstrosity ..... Please save us!
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has awoken the creature within the Carved Stone Tomb, You have been tasked with defeating the creature known as Razortusk in the deepest section of the Carved Stone Tomb.
rows.CompletedText: Thank you [PLAYERNAME]!, You have saved the Lost Paradise and given us access to the treasures within the Carved Stone Tomb.
rows.ArchiveText: At the request of [STARTNAME] you travelled to the deepest section of the Carved Stone Tomb and elimnated the threat of Razortusk[FINISHNAME]

rows.AcceptText: Good day to you [PLAYERNAME], It seems a slight problem has arisen, namely in the form of Skeletons that have taken over a number of caves. How about you deal with those for me and bring me back some spines to prove it?
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to remove the Skeleton threat from within the caves.
rows.CompletedText: Thank you [PLAYERNAME], Looks like we have another problem to deal with however.
rows.ArchiveText: You have defeated the horde of Skeletal mobs within the caves at the request of [FINISHNAME]

rows.AcceptText: It seems something more sinister is at hand, Those skeletons seemed to be receiving instructions from elsewhere, Maybe you should check that out?
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to find the SkeletonLord.
rows.CompletedText: Fantastic [PLAYERNAME], That seems to have done the job.
rows.ArchiveText: You cleared the Skeleton Lord out of the caves, [FINISHNAME] was very happy with your work.

rows.AcceptText: Hello [PLAYERNAME], I have a bit of a problem, one of those Scarecrows has gotten hold of the key for the Bichon Town Potion store. Could you get it for me?
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to get his key back from the Scarecrow.
rows.CompletedText: Thank you [PLAYERNAME] for returning my key, here is a little reward for you.
rows.ArchiveText: You managed to find [FINISHNAME]'s key for the Bichon Town Potion store, they were attached to a wandering Scarecrow.

rows.AcceptText: Hello [PLAYERNAME], I have a bit of a problem, one of those Scarecrows has gotten hold of the key for the Lost Paradise Potion store. Could you get it for me?
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to get his key back from the Scarecrow.
rows.CompletedText: Thank you [PLAYERNAME] for returning my key, here is a little reward for you.
rows.ArchiveText: You managed to find [FINISHNAME]'s key for the Lost Paradise Potion store, they were attached to a wandering Scarecrow.

rows.CompletedText: Thank you [PLAYERNAME] for returning my key, here is a little reward for you.
rows.ArchiveText: You managed to find [FINISHNAME]'s key for the Banya Village Potion store, they were attached to a wandering Scarecrow.

rows.AcceptText: How can I help you today [PLAYERNAME], actually maybe you could me. I've always wanted to try adding some Zombie flesh to my recipes, maybe you can acquire some?
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to gather Zombie Flesh from the Bichon Mines
rows.CompletedText: Well that certainly didn't taste as good as I expected, thank you anyway [PLAYERNAME]
rows.ArchiveText: [STARTNAME] asked you to find some Zombie Flesh from the Bichon Mines, apparently it didn't taste nice.

rows.AcceptText: Why hello there [PLAYERNAME]. I appear to have misplaced my journal. I'm fairly sure I saw one of those Claw Cats walking off with it though. Could you find it for me?.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] in Lost Paradise has asked you to find the his journal, He thinks a Claw Cat stole it.
rows.CompletedText: [PLAYERNAME] I cannot thank you enough!.
rows.ArchiveText: You returned the journal to [FINISHNAME] in Lost Paradise after recovering it from a Claw Cat.

rows.AcceptText: Why hello there [PLAYERNAME]. I appear to have misplaced my journal. I'm fairly sure I saw one of those Claw Cats walking off with it though. Could you find it for me?.

rows.CompletedText: [PLAYERNAME] I cannot thank you enough!.
rows.ArchiveText: You returned the journal to [FINISHNAME] in Bichon Town after recovering it from a Claw Cat.

rows.CompletedText: [PLAYERNAME] I cannot thank you enough!.
rows.ArchiveText: You returned the journal to [FINISHNAME] in Banya Village after recovering it from a Claw Cat.

rows.AcceptText: Hello [PLAYERNAME], Those pesky Forest Yeti have made a nuisance of themselves around Bichon Town, Could you go kill a few so we can open our trade routes again.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to kill some of the Forest Yeti population around Bichon Town.
rows.CompletedText: Thanks for that [PLAYERNAME], we can move our wares freely now.
rows.ArchiveText: You helped [STARTNAME] to defeat the Forest Yeti around Bichon Town.

rows.AcceptText: Hello [PLAYERNAME], Bichon Town supplies have been running low recently, could you help us restock our supplies of Edible Chestnuts?
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to gather Edible chestnuts from Chestnut trees around Bichon Town.
rows.CompletedText: These will help out greatly, Thank you [PLAYERNAME].
rows.ArchiveText: You were able to forage enough Edible Chestnuts to assist the people of Bichon Town.

rows.AcceptText: [PLAYERNAME] please I must speak with you, Strange rumours are emanating from travellers venturing in to the Banya Stone Caves. Talk of the undead rising once again are rife, could you check it out?
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to venture into the Banya Stone Caves in order to identify if the rumours were true or not.
rows.CompletedText: I can't believe it [PLAYERNAME], This is an ominous sign.
rows.ArchiveText: [STARTNAME] asked you to venture into the Banya Stone Caves in order to validate the rumours circulating around Banya Village.

rows.AcceptText: [PLAYERNAME] We must investigate this further, I'm concerned that even fiercer creatures may lurk deeper into the Banya Stone Caves, You must go quickly and find out for me.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] is concerned that even more dangerous creatures inhabit the deeper sections of Banya Stone Cave, you have been sent to investigate.
rows.CompletedText: It's exactly as I feared, We must stop this threat before it becomes too much.
rows.ArchiveText: [STARTNAME] requested you travel deeper into the Banya Stone Caves in order to confirm his fears of even more dangerous creatures.

rows.AcceptText: [PLAYERNAME] we have to hit back and hit hard, The entrance to the kings room is guarded by a small army of undead and the generals that control them, please go and slay them.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has sent you to strike back at the Skeletal enemies found within Banya Stone Cave and the Bone Enforcer that controls them.
rows.CompletedText: This was exactly what we needed, take some time to prepare yourself for the final encounter.
rows.ArchiveText: [STARTNAME] sent you to destroy the skeletal forces located deep within Banya Stone Caves.

rows.AcceptText: [PLAYERNAME] It's time for us to end this, You must travel to the Deepest floor of Banya Stone Cave and destroy Arch Lich Taedu who lives within.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has sent you to defeat Arch Lich Taedu in Banya Stone Cave
rows.CompletedText: You are a true Hero [PLAYERNAME], The Village is safe once again.
rows.ArchiveText: [STARTNAME] sent you to defeat Arch Lich Taedu in the deepest sections of Banya Stone Caves.

rows.AcceptText: Welcome to Lost Paradise [PLAYERNAME], If you could spare a moment of time it would be greatly appreciated if you could rid the Town of some Wolves.
rows.ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to kill some of the Wolves stalking around Lost Paradise.
rows.CompletedText: Marvelous [PLAYERNAME], That should keep the town safer for a while
rows.ArchiveText: You helped [STARTNAME] to defeat the Wolves around Lost Paradise.

rows.AcceptText: 万事通在望海楼设宴相邀。[PLAYERNAME]携本线的神舰线索赴约，与万事通对谈，拼出老矿工"三态"之谜，获赠船歌谣残片，正式接入共享主线。
rows.ProgressText: 前往比奇城望海楼，与万事通会面（0/1）。
rows.CompletedText: 三态之谜拼成：老矿工陈永年，肉身在比奇矿、神志在废矿、魂锁在白日门矿井——同一人，三种状态，全是"船"留下的伤。万事通把一枚旧铜哨推到你面前："这是船上的规矩。船，要开了。"
rows.ArchiveText: 望海楼之约，[PLAYERNAME]拼出老矿工三态之谜，得知"海上大船是牢笼"的真相，自万事通处获赠船歌谣残片。共享主线自此开启。

rows.AcceptText: 老矿工陈永年兑现"一刺保命"的承诺：请[PLAYERNAME]以骷髅祭坛旧址为靶，猎取骷髅战将的骨粉，磨砺"洞穴里活命的一刺"。
rows.ProgressText: 前往骷髅祭坛旧址，击杀骷髅战将（0/6），收集骨粉（0/3）。
rows.CompletedText: 骨粉入怀，老矿工以矿镐为剑，演示那记千年矿洞里磨出来的刺杀："怪物扑来时，怕的人先死。这一刺，要快，要狠，要往它最软的地方去。"
rows.ArchiveText: 老矿工将毕生保命的一刺传予[PLAYERNAME]，刺杀剑术习得。矿洞之约，兑现。
